title: escalation-bridge-hotpatch-and-observability-payload
creator: Aisha Malik
summary: Multiple enterprise tenants observed a correlated spike of 5xx responses and request timeouts on the Hosted API during a model rollout window; widespread client retries amplified the failure wave. This ticket coordinates the hotpatch, short-term mitigations, and longer-term fixes plus customer comms.

2026-03-10T02:10Z - Root-cause hypothesis: kvcache compaction + model rollout kernel mismatch => tail latency increases; SDK clients continued aggressive retries causing proxy exhaustion.

reproduction_steps: Create an integration-level test that issues concurrent requests replicating tenant traffic profile (p50 payload size, p95 concurrency).
Trigger a simulated model rollout that changes kernel/quantization path and forces KV cache compaction on serving nodes.
Use the SDK configured with default retry policy (3 retries, exponential backoff) and observe connection pool saturation at the edge proxy under high tail latency.
Measure per-request latency histograms with tracing enabled (edge -> proxy -> runtime) to reproduce tail amplification.
investigation_notes: Edge proxy metrics showed connection saturation: pool_size was exhausted before backoff completed, leading to queued requests and increased latency leading to 5xx from runtime.
KV cache compaction triggered after a model shard change; compaction pauses increased P95 token-generation latency on some GPUs by 4-6x briefly.
Client SDKs treat 5xx/timeouts as safe to retry immediately; with concurrent failures this produced retry amplification.
Several tenants with aggressive client retry settings and high concurrency (internal telemetry) accounted for >60% of additional load during the burst.
Failure mode was systemic only when model rollout coincided with compact events and peak tenant concurrency; otherwise failures were attenuated.
decisions: Ship immediate edge proxy fast-fail (return 429/503 with Retry-After for tenants exceeding dynamic token budget) to break retry amplification cycles (implemented via PR #3489).
Rollback the active model rollout that triggered kernel/compaction mismatch while we harden rollout checks (PR #3492).
Publish recommended SDK retry semantics and set tenant-level adaptive throttling defaults for hosted customers.
Add a preflight check in the rollout pipeline to detect ongoing compaction/long-tail operations before touching serving nodes.
